query:
SELECT id
        FROM audit_log
        WHERE actor = $1
          AND (($2::uuid IS NULL AND agent_id IS NULL) OR agent_id = $2)
          AND action = $3
          AND status = $4
          AND detail = $5::jsonb
          AND (client_ip IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $7::text)
          AND ts > NOW() - ($6::bigint * INTERVAL '1 second')
        ORDER BY ts DESC
        LIMIT 1
